notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3537740/Stick_Robot_Puzzle_Demo"][/dynamiclink]I've updated the demo version of StickRobotPuzzle.


There are no changes to the puzzle content itself, but...



Added "mysteries" to the world map (you'll be able to solve them in the full version)


Adjusted controls to feel more intuitive


Made the player robot feel more squishy


Added ambient sounds


Other minor changes



...and more.


The full version is almost complete and should be released in August!


HIKO

notes.title: Development Log – May 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!


🗺 Progress on the World Map

The path from Stage 1 to the final stage on the world map is now complete!  
I'm currently adding a few hidden paths and making movement between stages a bit more convenient.  
I’d say it’s about 90% done.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005089/b967a8ca8c79d820bf25964761272b300295d268.png"]


🧩 Puzzle Stage Refinement

All puzzle stages are already complete, but I’m currently polishing up some elements—especially player guidance and overall feel—to make them smoother and more intuitive.


🎵 Asset Refinement (Especially the Music!)

The audio assets were made a long time ago when I first built a prototype of this game.  
I've finally started replacing and refining them—something that’s been on the to-do list for a while!  
It’s refreshing to hear the game with improved sound.


📅 Release Date Confirmed

I'm excited to announce that StickRobotPuzzle will be released on August 1st, 2025 (Friday)!


There’s still a chance the date may shift slightly, but this is the deadline I’ve set for now—and I’ll be doing my best to hit it.



That’s all for now. Thanks again for your continued support!



🛒 Check out the store page here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2846550/Stick_Robot_Puzzle/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Thank you for checking out the game!

The demo has been updated.

While the stages themselves haven't changed, a world map has been added, allowing you to move around the world as part of the puzzle.

In addition, a Linux version is now available!
It works on Steam Deck.

We hope you enjoy it!
